crossRefs.note: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and…
Then Yahweh may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to…
Now therefore, may Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him…
As for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land…
